music.title: Les Danaïdes
music.description: Salieri's opera turns Danaus' flight and the wedding-night murders into Enlightenment tragedy — the fifty daughters, the fifty cousins, and the father's command.

popCulture.title: The Suppliants
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus brings Danaus and his daughters to Argos as refugees — the father who flees Aegyptus' sons and asks Pelasgus for asylum under Zeus of the suppliant.

popCulture.title: Danaïdes
popCulture.description: Danaus' daughters became a byword: the Danaids who kill their bridegrooms and, in the underworld, fill leaking jars forever — his name carried by their punishment.
